demo.title: Draw something.
demo.lede: My model will try to guess what it is — live, while you draw.
demo.prompt: It knows 15 doodles. Try an apple, a bicycle, an umbrella — or whatever you like.

predictions.heading: My best guesses
predictions.emptyHint: Start drawing and the guesses appear here.

demo.privacyNote: Anonymous. Your drawing and your verdict may be used to help train the model — no account, no tracking, nothing that identifies you.

states.warmingUp: Waking the model up — it scales to zero between visitors, which is rather the point. One moment.
states.unreachable: The model is offline right now. Here is a recording of it in action — the live demo returns when the service is back up.

teasers.title: Behind the Scenes
teasers.body: That doodle didn't just get guessed — it ran through a real machine: a model that trains itself on every change, a gate that can refuse to ship, and infrastructure that builds and destroys itself on a schedule.

teasers.title: The Journey
teasers.body: The decisions, the wrong turns, and the reasons behind them — written while building, not polished after.

teasers.title: Skills
teasers.body: The tools I reached for on this project — each one tied to the exact place it earns its keep.
